meta.title: Ask-every clarification protocol
meta.description: Coverage-first clarification plus an engine-level hard gate: decompose the task into confirmed subtasks, ask the task-type template's required items (with one follow-up round), present five-field plan cards, replay the requirement (facts / inferences / open items) for correction, then a fixed execute_gate click to start. The hard gate (on by default) is a tool guard that denies every non-allowlisted tool call until the user clicks go; sessions stay locked across restarts. Modes lite/standard/deep; hardGate: false for prompt-only mode.
